newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Lazio seek London bourse listing by end 97.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Lazio seek London bourse listing by end 97.

text.p: Rome-based soccer club Lazio will float on the London stock exchange by the end of the year, the serie A club's owner and majority shareholder Sergio Cragnotti said on Monday.
"We'll start the operation to float Lazio on the London bourse in September. It will be complete by December," he told reporters.
Cragnotti, also president of financial holding Cirio Finanziaria, has said previously he wants Lazio to be the first soccer club in Italy to float.
A number of Italian serie A clubs, including AC Milan and Bologna, are believed to be interested in seeking a bourse listing, but none have so far taken the plunge.
